summary.text: STORD24 AS is a private limited company registered in Stord, founded 2017-01-24. Its website describes the business as follows: "Les nyheter, artikler og se videoer fra Stord24". Its main industry code is 90.111: arts creation activities in literature. It has 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 4 130 000 NOK and the annual result was 208 000 NOK; operating income was up from 3 389 000 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 62 000 NOK in 2024 to 208 000 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from -337 000 NOK in 2024 to -129 000 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is stord24.no. Recent changes in the register: employees set to None on 2026-07-16.
